title: Awesome Tech Talks segment record
description: Schema specification for segment records in the Awesome Tech Talks dataset hosted on Hugging Face (tech_talks_segments.parquet).

segment_id.description: Unique identifier for the segment (video_id plus segment index).

title.description: Title of the talk or session.

company.description: Organization that hosted or published the session.

channel.description: Channel name where the video was originally uploaded.

upload_date.description: Original publication date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), or unknown.

duration_seconds.description: Total duration of the full video in seconds.

url.description: Source URL to the original session, if available.

topics.description: List of standardized topic tags assigned to the session.

qc_flags.description: Quality control or validation notices, if any.

segment_index.description: Positional index of the segment within the video.

total_segments.description: Total count of segments for this video.

heading.description: Extracted section heading or topic transition title.

heading_confidence.description: Confidence level of the heading extraction (high or low).

start_time.description: Timestamp offset where the segment begins (HH:MM:SS or MM:SS).

text.description: Cleaned, normalized transcript text for the segment.

word_count.description: Total word count of the segment.
